mn36:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
mn36:2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pavisitukāmo hoti.
mn36:3.1: atha kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena mahāvanaṃ kūṭāgārasālā tenupasaṅkami.
mn36:3.2: addasā kho āyasmā ānando saccakaṃ nigaṇṭhaputtaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
mn36:3.4: “ayaṃ bhante saccako nigaṇṭhaputto āgacchati bhassappavādako paṇḍitavādo sādhusammato bahujanassa.
mn36:3.5: eso kho bhante avaṇṇakāmo buddhassa, avaṇṇakāmo dhammassa, avaṇṇakāmo saṅghassa.
mn36:3.6: sādhu bhante bhagavā muhuttaṃ nisīdatu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
mn36:3.8: atha kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn36:4.1: santi bho gotama eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kāyabhāvanānuyogamanuyuttā viharanti. no cittabhāvanaṃ.
mn36:4.2: phusanti hi te bho gotama sārīrikaṃ dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ.
mn36:4.3: bhūtapubbaṃ bho gotama sārīrikāya dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭhassa sato ūrukkhambhopi nāma bhavissati, hadayampi nāma phālissati, uṇhampi lohitaṃ mukhato uggamissati, ummādampi pāpuṇissati cittakkhepaṃ.
mn36:4.4: tassa kho etaṃ bho gotama kāyanvayaṃ cittaṃ hoti, kāyassa vasena vattati.
mn36:4.7: santi pana bho gotama eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā cittabhāvanānuyogamanuyuttā viharanti, no kāyabhāvanaṃ.
mn36:4.8: phusanti hi te bho gotama cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ.
mn36:4.9: bhūtapubbaṃ bho gotama cetasikāya dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭhassa sato ūrukkhambhopi nāma bhavissati, hadayampi nāma phālissati, uṇhampi lohitaṃ mukhato uggamissati, ummādampi pāpuṇissati cittakkhepaṃ.
mn36:4.10: tassa kho eso bho gotama cittanvayo kāyo hoti, cittassa vasena vattati.
mn36:4.13: tassa mayhaṃ bho gotama evaṃ hoti:
mn36:4.14: addhā bhoto gotamassa sāvakā cittabhāvanānuyogamanuyuttā viharanti, no kāyabhāvananti.
mn36:5.1: kinti pana te aggivessana kāyabhāvanā sutāti?
mn36:5.3: nando vaccho, kiso saṃkicco, makkhali gosālo –
mn36:5.4: ete hi bho gotama acelakā muttācārā hatthāpalekhanā, na ehi bhadantikā, na tiṭṭha bhadantikā, na abhihaṭaṃ na uddissakaṭaṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyanti.
mn36:5.5: te na kumbhimukhā patigaṇhanti, na kaḷopimukhā patigaṇhanti, na eḷakamantaraṃ, na daṇḍamantaraṃ, na musalamantaraṃ, na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ, na gabbhiniyā, na pāyamānāya, na purisantaragatāya, na saṅkittīsu, na yattha sā upaṭṭhito hoti, na yattha makkhikā saṇḍasaṇḍacārinī, na macchaṃ, na maṃsaṃ, na suraṃ, na merayaṃ, na thusodakaṃ pivanti.
mn36:5.6: te ekāgārikā vā honti ekālopikā, dvāgārikā vā honti dvālopikā, sattāgārikā vā honti sattālopikā.
mn36:5.7: ekissāpi dattiyā yāpenti, dvīhipi dattīhi yāpenti, sattahipi dattīhi yāpenti.
mn36:5.8: ekāhikampi āhāraṃ āhārenti, dvīhikampi āhāraṃ āhārenti, sattāhikampi āhāraṃ āhārenti. iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikampi pariyāyabhattabhojanānuyogamanuyuttā viharantī”ti.
mn36:6.1: kiṃ pana te aggivessana tāvatakeneva yāpentīti?
mn36:6.3: appekadā bho gotama uḷārāni uḷārāni khādanīyāni khādanti. uḷārāni uḷārāni bhojaniyāni bhuñjanti. uḷārāni uḷārāni sāyanīyāni sāyanti. uḷārāni uḷārāni pānāni pivanti.
mn36:6.4: te imaṃ kāyaṃ gāhenti nāma, brūhenti nāma, medenti nāmā”ti.
mn36:6.5: yaṃ kho te aggivessana purimaṃ pahāya pacchā upacinanti, evaṃ imassa kāyassa ācayāpacayo hoti.
mn36:6.6: kinti pana te aggivessana cittabhāvanā sutāti?
mn36:6.7: cittabhāvanāya kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavatā puṭṭho samāno na sampāyāsi.
mn36:7.1: atha kho bhagavā saccakaṃ nigaṇṭhaputtaṃ etadavoca:
mn36:7.2: yāpi kho te esā aggivessana purimā kāyabhāvanā bhāsitā, sāpi ariyassa vinaye no dhammikā kāyabhāvanā.
mn36:7.3: kāyabhāvanaṃ hi kho tvaṃ aggivessana na aññāsi, kuto pana tvaṃ cittabhāvanaṃ jānissasi?
mn36:7.4: api ca aggivessana yathā abhāvitakāyo ca hoti abhāvitacitto ca, bhāvitakāyo ca bhāvitacitto ca,
mn36:7.6: evaṃ bho’ti kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavato paccassosi.
mn36:8.1: kathañca aggivessana abhāvitakāyo ca hoti abhāvitacitto ca?
mn36:8.2: idha aggivessana assutavato puthujjanassa uppajjati sukhā vedanā.
mn36:8.3: so sukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno sukhasārāgī ca hoti, sukhasārāgitañca āpajjati.
mn36:8.5: sukhāya vedanāya nirodhā uppajjati dukkhā vedanā.
mn36:8.6: so dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati.
mn36:8.7: tassa kho esā aggivessana uppannāpi sukhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati abhāvitattā kāyassa. uppannāpi dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati abhāvitattā cittassa.
mn36:8.8: yassa kassaci aggivessana evaṃ ubhatopakkhaṃ uppannāpi sukhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati abhāvitattā kāyassa, uppannāpi dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati abhāvitattā cittassa, evaṃ kho aggivessana abhāvitakāyo ca hoti abhāvitacitto ca.
mn36:9.1: kathañca aggivessana bhāvitakāyo ca hoti bhāvitacitto ca?
mn36:9.2: idha aggivessana sutavato ariyasāvakassa uppajjati sukhā vedanā.
mn36:9.3: so sukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno na sukhasārāgī ca hoti, na sukhasārāgitañca āpajjati.
mn36:9.5: sukhāya vedanāya nirodhā uppajjati dukkhā vedanā.
mn36:9.6: so dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷiṃ kandati, na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
mn36:9.7: tassa kho esā aggivessana uppannāpi sukhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati bhāvitattā kāyassa. uppannāpi dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati bhāvitattā cittassa.
mn36:9.8: yassa kassacī aggivessana evaṃ ubhatopakkhaṃ uppannāpi sukhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati bhāvitattā kāyassa, uppannāpi dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati bhāvitattā cittassa, evaṃ kho aggivessana bhāvitakāyo ca hoti bhāvitacitto cāti.
mn36:10.2: bhavaṃ hi gotamo bhāvitakāyo ca bhāvitacitto cā”ti.
mn36:10.3: addhā kho te ayaṃ aggivessana āsajja upanīya vācā bhāsitā.
mn36:10.5: yato kho ahaṃ aggivessana kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito, taṃ vata me uppannā vā sukhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, uppannā vā dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti netaṃ kho ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti.
mn36:11.1: “nahanūna bhoto gotamassa uppajjati tathārūpā sukhā vedanā yathārūpā uppannā sukhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭheyya, nahanūna bhoto gotamassa uppajjati tathārūpā dukkhā vedanā, yathārūpā uppannā dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭheyyāti.”
mn36:12.2: idha me aggivessana pubbeva sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi:
mn36:12.4: nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṃkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
mn36:12.5: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyanti.
mn36:13.1: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana aparena samayena daharova samāno susukāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā akāmakānaṃ mātāpitunnaṃ assumukhānaṃ rudantānaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ.
mn36:13.2: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn36:13.3: icchāmahaṃ āvuso kālāma imasmiṃ dhammavinaye brahmacariyaṃ caritunti.
mn36:13.4: evaṃ vutte aggivessana āḷāro kālāmo maṃ etadavoca:
mn36:13.6: tādiso ayaṃ dhammo yattha viññū puriso nacirasseva sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyā’ti.
mn36:13.7: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana nacirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇiṃ.
mn36:13.8: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana tāvatakeneva oṭṭhapahatamattena lapitalāpanamattena ñāṇavādañca vadāmi, theravādañca. ‘jānāmi passāmī’ti ca paṭijānāmi, ahañceva aññe ca.
mn36:13.10: na kho āḷāro kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedeti.
mn36:13.11: addhā āḷāro kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharatīti.
mn36:13.12: atha khvāhaṃ aggivessana yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn36:13.13: kittāvatā no āvuso kālāma imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesīti?
mn36:13.14: evaṃ vutte aggivessana āḷāro kālāmo ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ pavedesi.
mn36:13.16: “na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi saddhā, mayhampatthi saddhā;
mn36:13.17: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi viriyaṃ, mayhampatthi viriyaṃ;
mn36:13.18: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi sati, mayhampatthi sati;
mn36:13.19: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi samādhi, mayhampatthi samādhi;
mn36:13.20: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi paññā, mayhampatthi paññā.
mn36:13.21: yannūnāhaṃ yaṃ dhammaṃ āḷāro kālāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedeti, tassa dhammassa sacchikiriyāya padaheyyanti.”
mn36:13.22: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana na cirasse va khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn36:14.1: atha khvāhaṃ aggivessana yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn36:14.2: ettāvatā no āvuso kālāma imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesīti.
mn36:14.3: “ettāvatā kho ahaṃ āvuso imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemī”ti.
mn36:14.4: “ahampi kho āvuso ettāvatā imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī”ti.
mn36:14.6: ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ passāma:
mn36:14.7: iti yāhaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemi, taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi.
mn36:14.8: yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi, tamahaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemi.
mn36:14.9: iti yāhaṃ dhammaṃ jānāmi, taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi. yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi, tamahaṃ dhammaṃ jānāmi.
mn36:14.10: iti yādiso ahaṃ, tādiso tvaṃ. yādiso tvaṃ, tādiso ahaṃ.
mn36:14.11: ehidāni āvuso, ubhova santā imaṃ gaṇaṃ pariharāmā”ti.
mn36:14.12: iti kho aggivessana āḷāro kālāmo ācariyo me samāno antevāsiṃ maṃ samānaṃ attano samasamaṃ ṭhapesi. uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi.
mn36:14.14: nāyaṃ dhammo nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāvadeva ākiñcaññāyatanūpapattiyāti.
mn36:14.15: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana taṃ dhammaṃ analaṅkaritvā tasmā dhammā nibbijja apakkamiṃ.
mn36:15.1: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena uddako rāmaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā uddakaṃ rāmaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn36:15.2: icchāmahaṃ āvuso imasmiṃ dhammavinaye brahmacariyaṃ caritunti.
mn36:15.3: evaṃ vutte aggivessana uddako rāmaputto maṃ etadavoca:
mn36:15.5: tādiso ayaṃ dhammo yattha viññū puriso na cirasseva sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyā”ti.
mn36:15.6: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana na cirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇiṃ.
mn36:15.7: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana tāvatakeneva oṭṭhapahatamattena lapitalāpanamattena ñāṇavādañca vadāmi theravādañca. ‘jānāmi passāmī’ti ca paṭijānāmi, ahañceva aññe ca.
mn36:15.9: na kho rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedesi.
mn36:15.10: addhā rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ vihāsīti.
mn36:15.11: atha khvāhaṃ aggivessana yena uddako rāmaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā uddakaṃ rāmaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn36:15.12: kittāvatā no āvuso rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedesīti.
mn36:15.13: evaṃ vutte aggivessana uddako rāmaputto nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ pavedesi.
mn36:15.15: na kho rāmasseva ahosi saddhā, mayhampatthi saddhā;
mn36:15.16: na kho rāmasseva ahosi viriyaṃ, mayhampatthi viriyaṃ;
mn36:15.17: na kho rāmasseva ahosi sati, mayhampatthi sati;
mn36:15.18: na kho rāmasseva ahosi samādhi, mayhampatthi samādhi;
mn36:15.19: na kho rāmasseva ahosi paññā, mayhampatthi paññā.
mn36:15.20: yannūnāhaṃ yaṃ dhammaṃ rāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedesi, tassa dhammassa sacchikiriyāya padaheyyanti.
mn36:15.21: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana na cirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn36:15.22: atha khvāhaṃ aggivessana yena uddako rāmaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā uddakaṃ rāmaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn36:15.23: ettāvatā no āvuso rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesīti.
mn36:15.24: “ettāvatā kho āvuso rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesī”ti.
mn36:15.25: ahampi kho āvuso ettāvatā imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti.
mn36:15.27: ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ passāma:
mn36:15.28: iti yaṃ dhammaṃ rāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesi, taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi. yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi, taṃ dhammaṃ rāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesi.
mn36:15.29: iti yaṃ dhammaṃ rāmo aññāsi, taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi. yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi, taṃ dhammaṃ rāmo aññāsi.
mn36:15.30: iti yādiso rāmo ahosi, tādiso tvaṃ, yādiso tvaṃ, tādiso rāmo ahosi.
mn36:15.31: ehidāni āvuso, tvaṃ imaṃ gaṇaṃ pariharā ”ti.
mn36:15.32: iti kho aggivessana uddako rāmaputto sabrahmacārī me samāno ācariyaṭṭhāne ca maṃ ṭhapesi, uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi.
mn36:15.34: nāyaṃ dhammo nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāvadeva nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpapattiyāti.
mn36:15.35: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana taṃ dhammaṃ analaṅkaritvā tasmā dhammā nibbijja apakkamiṃ.
mn36:16.1: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno magadhesu anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena uruvelā senā-nigamo tadavasariṃ.
mn36:16.2: tatthaddasaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ bhūmibhāgaṃ pāsādikañca vanasaṇḍaṃ, nadiñca sandantiṃ setakaṃ supatitthaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ, samantā ca gocaragāmaṃ.
mn36:16.4: ramaṇīyo vata bhūmibhāgo, pāsādiko ca vanasaṇḍo. nadī ca sandati setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā, samantā ca gocaragāmo.
mn36:16.6: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana tattheva nisīdiṃ
mn36:17.1: apissu maṃ aggivessana tisso upamā paṭibhaṃsu anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā:
mn36:17.2: seyyathāpi aggivessana allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ udake nikkhittaṃ,
mn36:17.6: api nu so puriso amuṃ allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ udake nikkhittaṃ uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya abhimanthento aggiṃ abhinibbatteyya, tejo pātu kareyyāti?
mn36:17.9: “aduṃ hi bho gotama allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ. tañca pana udake nikkhittaṃ.
mn36:17.10: yāvadeva ca pana so puriso kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assā”ti.
mn36:17.11: evameva kho aggivessana ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kāyena ceva kāmehi avūpakaṭṭhā viharanti, yo ca nesaṃ kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho, so ca ajjhattaṃ na suppahīno hoti na suppaṭippassaddho. opakkamikā cepi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti. abhabbā’va te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
mn36:17.12: no cepi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti, abhabbāva te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
mn36:17.13: ayaṃ kho maṃ aggivessana paṭhamā upamā paṭibhāsi anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā.
mn36:18.1: aparāpi kho maṃ aggivessana dutiyā upamā paṭibhāsi anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā:
mn36:18.2: seyyathāpi aggivessana allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ ārakā udakā thale nikkhittaṃ.
mn36:18.6: api nu so puriso amuṃ allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ ārakā udakā thale nikkhittaṃ uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya abhimanthento aggiṃ abhinibbatteyya, tejo pātu kareyyāti?
mn36:18.9: “aduṃ hi bho gotama allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ kiñcāpi ārakā udakā thale nikkhittaṃ.
mn36:18.10: yāvadeva ca pana so puriso kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assā”ti.
mn36:18.11: evameva kho aggivessana ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kāyena kho kāmehi vūpakaṭṭhā viharanti, yo ca nesaṃ kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho so ca ajjhattaṃ na suppahīno hoti, na suppaṭippassaddho. opakkamikā cepi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti. abhabbāva te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya. no cepi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti, abhabbāva te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
mn36:18.12: ayaṃ kho maṃ aggivessana dutiyā upamā paṭibhāsi anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā.
mn36:19.1: aparāpi kho maṃ aggivessana tatiyā upamā paṭibhāsi anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā:
mn36:19.2: seyyathāpi aggivessana sukkhaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ koḷāpaṃ ārakā udakā thale nikkhittaṃ,
mn36:19.6: api nū so puriso amuṃ sukkhaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ koḷāpaṃ ārakā udakā thale nikkhittaṃ uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya abhimanthento aggiṃ abhinibbatteyya, tejo pātukareyyāti?
mn36:19.9: “aduṃ hi bho gotama sukkhaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ koḷāpaṃ, tañca pana ārakā udakā thale nikkhittanti.”
mn36:19.10: evameva kho aggivessana ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kāyena ceva kāmehi vūpakaṭṭhā viharanti, yo ca nesaṃ kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho so ca ajjhattaṃ suppahīno hoti suppaṭippassaddho. opakkamikā cepi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti, bhabbāva te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya. no cepi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti, bhabbāva te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
mn36:19.11: ayaṃ kho maṃ aggivessana tatiyā upamā paṭibhāsi anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā.
mn36:19.12: imā kho maṃ aggivessana tisso upamā paṭibhaṃsu anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā.
mn36:20.2: yannūnāhaṃ dante’bhidantamādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇheyyaṃ abhinippīḷeyyaṃ abhisantāpeyyanti.
mn36:20.3: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana dante’bhidantamādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhāmi abhinippīḷemi abhisantāpemi.
mn36:20.4: tassa mayhaṃ aggivessana dante’bhidantamādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhayato abhinippīḷayato abhisantāpayato kacchehi sedā muccanti.
mn36:20.5: seyyathāpi aggivessana balavā puriso dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ sīse vā gahetvā khandhe vā gahetvā abhiniggaṇheyya abhinippīḷeyya abhisantāpeyya,
mn36:20.6: evameva kho me aggivessana dante’bhidantamādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasācittaṃ abhiniggaṇhayato abhinippīḷayato abhisantāpayato kacchehi sedā muccanti.
mn36:20.7: āraddhaṃ kho pana me aggivessana viriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ. upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā. sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho teneva dukkhappadhānena padhānābhitunnassa sato.
mn36:20.8: evarūpāpi kho me aggivessana uppannā dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
mn36:21.3: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana mukhato ca nāsato ca assāsapassāse uparundhiṃ.
mn36:21.4: tassa mayhaṃ aggivessana mukhato ca nāsato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu kaṇṇasotehi vātānaṃ nikkhamantānaṃ adhimatto saddo hoti.
mn36:21.5: seyyathāpi nāma kammāragaggariyā dhamamānāya adhimatto saddo hoti,
mn36:21.6: evameva kho me aggivessana mukhato ca nāsato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu kaṇṇasotehi vātānaṃ nikkhamantānaṃ adhimatto saddo hoti.

mn36:22.5: seyyathāpi aggivessana balavā puriso tiṇhena sikharena muddhāni abhimantheyya,

mn36:23.4: tassa mayhaṃ aggivessana mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimattā sīse sīsavedanā honti.
mn36:23.5: seyyathāpi aggivessana balavā puriso daḷhena varattakakhandhanena sīse sīsaveṭhaṃ dadeyya,
mn36:23.6: evameva kho me aggivessana mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimattā sīse sīsavedanā honti.

mn36:24.5: seyyathāpi aggivessana dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā tiṇhena govikantanena kucchiṃ parikanteyya,

mn36:24.8: evarūpāpi kho me aggivessana uppannā dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.

mn36:25.5: seyyathāpi aggivessana, dve balavanto purisā dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuyā santāpeyyuṃ samparitāpeyyuṃ,

mn36:25.7: āraddhaṃ kho pana me aggivessana viriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ. upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā. sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho teneva dukkhappadhānena padhānābhitunnassa sato.
mn36:25.8: evarūpāpi kho me aggivessana uppannā dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
mn36:26.1: apissu maṃ aggivessana devatā disvā evamāhaṃsu:
mn36:26.4: na kālakato samaṇo gotamo, api ca kālaṃ karotī’ti.
mn36:26.6: ‘na kālakato samaṇo gotamo, napi kālaṃ karoti. arahaṃ samaṇo gotamo. vihārotveveso arahato evarūpo hotī’ti.
mn36:27.3: atha kho maṃ aggivessana devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ:
mn36:27.4: mā kho tvaṃ mārisa sabbaso āhārūpacchedāya paṭipajji.
mn36:27.5: sace kho tvaṃ mārisa sabbaso āhārūpacchedāya paṭipajjissasi, tassa te mayaṃ dibbaṃ ojaṃ lomakūpehi ajjhohāressāma tāya tvaṃ yāpessasīti.
mn36:27.7: ahañceva kho pana sabbaso ajaddhukaṃ paṭijāneyyaṃ, imā ca me devatā dibbaṃ ojaṃ lomakūpehi ajjhohāreyyuṃ, tāya cāhaṃ yāpeyyaṃ, taṃ mama assa musāti.
mn36:27.8: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana tā devatā paccācikkhāmi, halanti vadāmi.
mn36:28.2: yannūnāhaṃ thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhāreyyaṃ pasataṃ pasataṃ – yadi vā muggayūsaṃ yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ yadi vā hareṇukayūsanti.
mn36:28.3: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ pasataṃ pasataṃ – yadi vā muggayūsaṃ yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ yadi vā hareṇukayūsaṃ.
mn36:28.4: tassa mayhaṃ aggivessana thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhārayato pasataṃ pasataṃ – yadi vā muggayūsaṃ yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ yadi vā hareṇukayūsaṃ, adhimattakasimānaṃ patto kāyo hoti.
mn36:28.5: seyyathāpi nāma āsītikapabbāni vā kāḷapabbāni vā, evamevassu me aṅgapaccaṅgāni bhavanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn36:28.6: seyyathāpi nāma oṭṭhapadaṃ, evamevassu me ānisadaṃ hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn36:28.7: seyyathāpi nāma vaṭṭanāvaḷī, evamevassu me piṭṭhikaṇṭako unnatāvanato hoti, tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn36:28.8: seyyathāpi nāma jarasālāya gopānasiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti, evamevassu me phāsuḷiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti tāyevappāhāratāya. –
mn36:28.9: seyyathāpi nāma gambhīre udapāne udakatārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti, evamevassu me akkhikūpesu akkhitārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn36:28.10: seyyathāpi nāma tittakālāpu āmakacchinno vātātapena sampuṭito hoti sammilāto, evamevassu me sīsacchavi samphuṭitā hoti sammilātā tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn36:28.11: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana udaracchaviṃ parāmasissāmīti piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃyeva parigaṇhāmi. piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ parāmasissāmīti udaracchaviññeva parigaṇhāmi. yāvassu me aggivessana udaracchavi piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ allīnā hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn36:28.12: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana vaccaṃ vā muttaṃ vā karissāmīti tattheva avakujjo papatāmi tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn36:28.13: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana imameva kāyaṃ assāsento pāṇinā gattāni anumajjāmi. tassa mayhaṃ aggivessana pāṇinā gattāni anumajjato pūtimūlāni lomāni kāyasmā papatanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn36:29.1: apissu maṃ aggivessana manussā disvā evamāhaṃsu: kāḷo samaṇo gotamoti.
mn36:29.2: ekacce manussā evamāhaṃsu: na kāḷo samaṇo gotamo, sāmo samaṇo gotamoti.
mn36:29.3: ekacce manussā evamāhaṃsu: na kāḷo samaṇo gotamo napi sāmo, maṅguracchavi samaṇo gotamoti.
mn36:29.4: yāvassu me aggivessana tāva parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto upahato hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn36:30.2: “ye kho keci atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyiṃsu, etāvaparamaṃ, nayito bhiyyo.
mn36:30.3: yepi hi keci anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyissanti, etāvaparamaṃ, nayito bhiyyo.
mn36:30.4: yepi hi keci etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti, etāvaparamaṃ, nayito bhiyyo.
mn36:30.5: na kho panāhaṃ imāya kaṭukāya dukkarakārikāya adhigacchāmi uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ.
mn36:30.6: siyā nu kho añño maggo bodhāyā”ti.
mn36:31.2: abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ pitusakkassa kammante sītāya jambucchāyāya nisinno vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharitā.
mn36:31.3: siyā nu kho eso maggo bodhāyāti.
mn36:32.2: kinnu kho ahaṃ tassa sukhassa bhāyāmi yantaṃ sukhaṃ aññatreva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehīti.
mn36:32.4: na kho ahaṃ tassa sukhassa bhāyāmi yantaṃ sukhaṃ aññatreva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehīti.
mn36:33.2: na taṃ sukaraṃ sukhaṃ adhigantuṃ evaṃ adhimattakasimānaṃ pattakāyena, yannūnāhaṃ oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāreyyaṃ odanakummāsanti.
mn36:33.3: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ odanakummāsaṃ.
mn36:33.4: tena kho pana maṃ aggivessana samayena pañca bhikkhū paccupaṭṭhitā honti:
mn36:33.5: “yaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ adhigamissati taṃ no ārocessatī”ti.
mn36:33.6: yato kho ahaṃ aggivessana oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ odanakummāsaṃ, atha kho te pañca bhikkhū nibbijja pakkamiṃsu:
mn36:34.1: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhārito balaṃ gahetvā vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn36:34.2: evarūpāpi kho me aggivessana uppannā sukhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
mn36:35-37.1: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn36:35-37.2: evarūpāpi kho me aggivessana uppannā sukhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
mn36:35-37.3: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca vihāsiṃ sato ca sampajāno. sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedesiṃ. yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti: upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn36:35-37.4: evarūpāpi kho me aggivessana uppannā sukhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
mn36:35-37.5: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn36:35-37.6: eva rūpāpi kho me aggivessana uppannā sukhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
mn36:38.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
mn36:38.2: so anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi seyyathidaṃ:- “ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo tissopi jātiyo catassopi jātiyo pañcapi jātiyo dasapi jātiyo vīsatimpi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattārīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi, anekepi saṃvaṭṭakappe anekepi vivaṭṭakappe anekepi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe, “amutrāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto amutra upapādiṃ. tatrāpāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃ vaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto idhūpapanno”ti – iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi.
mn36:39.1: ayaṃ kho pana me aggivessana rattiyā paṭhame yāme paṭhamā vijjā adhigatā,
mn36:39.2: avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā, tamo vihato āloko uppanno, yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
mn36:39.3: evarūpāpi kho me aggivessana uppannā sukhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
mn36:40.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
mn36:40.2: so dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passāmi: cavamāne, uppajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāmi: ‘ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā; ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā’ti. iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passāmi cavamāne upapajjamāne. hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāmi: …pe…
mn36:41.1: ayaṃ kho pana me aggivessana rattiyā majjhime yāme dutiyā vijjā adhigatā,
mn36:41.2: avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā, tamo vihato āloko uppanno, yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
mn36:41.3: evarūpāpi kho me aggivessana uppannā sukhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
mn36:42.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
mn36:42.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
mn36:42.3: ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ āsavasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ āsavanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
mn36:43.1: tassa me evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha. bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha. avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha.
mn36:43.3: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti abbhaññāsiṃ.
mn36:44.1: ayaṃ kho pana me aggivessana rattiyā pacchime yāme tatiyā vijjā adhigatā.
mn36:44.2: avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā, tamo vihato āloko uppanno, yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
mn36:44.3: evarūpāpi kho me aggivessana uppannā sukhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
mn36:45.1: abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ aggivessana anekasatāya parisāya dhammaṃ desetā.
mn36:45.3: mameva ārabbha samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ desetīti.
mn36:45.4: na kho panetaṃ aggivessana evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn36:45.5: yāvadeva viññāpanatthāya tathāgato paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
mn36:45.6: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana tassāyeva kathāya pariyosāne tasmiṃyeva purimasmiṃ samādhinimitte ajjhattameva cittaṃ saṇṭhapemi sannisīdāpemi ekodiṃ karomi samādahāmi, yena sudaṃ niccakappaṃ viharāmīti.
mn36:45.8: abhijānāti pana bhavaṃ gotamo divā supitā”ti.
mn36:46.1: abhijānāmahaṃ aggivessana gimhānaṃ pacchime māse pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññāpetvā dakkhiṇena passena sato sampajāno niddaṃ okkamitāti.
mn36:46.2: “etaṃ kho bho gotama eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammohavihārasmiṃ vadantī”ti.
mn36:46.3: na kho aggivessana ettāvatā sammūḷho vā hoti asammūḷho vā.
mn36:46.4: api ca aggivessana yathā ca sammūḷho hoti asammūḷho ca,
mn36:46.5: taṃ suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi, bhāsissāmīti.
mn36:46.6: evaṃ bho gotamāti kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavato paccassosi.
mn36:47.1: yassa kassaci aggivessana ye āsavā saṅkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā appahīnā, tamahaṃ sammūḷhoti vadāmi.
mn36:47.2: āsavānaṃ hi aggivessana appahānā sammūḷho hoti.
mn36:47.3: yassa kassaci aggivessana ye āsavā saṅkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā pahīnā, tamahaṃ asammūḷhoti vadāmi.
mn36:47.4: āsavānaṃ hi aggivessana pahānā asammūḷho hoti.
mn36:47.5: tathāgatassa kho aggivessana ye āsavā saṅkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
mn36:47.6: seyyathāpi aggivessana tālo matthakacchinno abhabbo puna virūḷhiyā,
mn36:47.7: evameva kho aggivessana tathāgatassa ye āsavā saṅkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammāti.
mn36:48.1: evaṃ vutte saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn36:48.3: yāvañcidaṃ bhoto gotamassa evaṃ āsajja āsajja vuccamānassa upanītehi upanītehi vacanapathehi samudācariyamānassa chavivaṇṇo ceva pariyodāyati, mukhavaṇṇo ca vippasīdati, yathā taṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.”
mn36:48.4: “abhijānāmahaṃ bho gotama pūraṇaṃ kassapaṃ vādena vādaṃ samārabhitā.
mn36:48.5: sopi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho aññena aññaṃ paṭicari, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmesi, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātvākāsi.
mn36:48.6: bhoto kho pana gotamassa evaṃ āsajja āsajja vuccamānassa upanītehi upanītehi vacanapathehi samudācariyamānassa chavivaṇṇo ceva pariyodāyati, mukhavaṇṇo ca vippasīdati, yathā taṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
mn36:48.12: sopi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho aññena aññaṃ paṭicari, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmesi, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātvākāsi.
mn36:48.13: bhoto kho pana gotamassa evaṃ āsajja āsajja vuccamānassa upanītehi upanītehi vacanapathehi samudācariyamānassa chavivaṇṇo ceva pariyodāyati, mukhavaṇṇo ca vippasīdati, yathā taṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
mn36:48.14: handa ca dāni mayaṃ bho gotama gacchāma,
mn36:48.17: atha kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmīti.
